tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Create two workflow instances andone unrelated task on the same date. Reschedule only one instance;show old/new anchors andall affected tasks. Preserve completed task IDs,actual completer,timestamps,comments andattachments. Keep independent tasks unchanged. Apply a revision atomically or expose partial outcomes;retry cannot duplicate tasks. No tutorial date-filter deletion procedure is executed.

Complete T-1 as U-1 andthen correct displayed attribution to client C-1. Retain original event actor,time,reason andeditor;only one current user/contact attribution is allowed. Reopening andcompleting again creates a new event rather than overwriting history. Apply task-specific columns only where supported;other activities cannot inherit a misleading completer.

Assign synthetic T-1 to client C-1 in M-1;the client cannot access M-2 tasks. Notification opt-in does not imply email delivery. When C-1 marks complete,notify the responsible worker once andretain actor/time. A missing required upload remains unresolved until ingestion/hash andmatter filing are verified. Preserve task messages with matter context andtest duplicate notification events.

Create each documented recurrence pattern with a future start andend. Preview exact occurrences including month-end,leap-day andtimezone transitions. Editing one occurrence differs from changing future occurrences;completed history remains intact. A retry generates no duplicate occurrence. Require an explicit rule for invalid calendar dates andwhether the end is inclusive;do not infer it from the guide.

Let T-1 become overdue andcomplete between two review runs. Preserve deadline versions andlate intervals even if no manual Late tag was applied. Change a deadline after completion andretain the original evidence. A1000-row page cannot establish full coverage when1001 tasks match. Reports identify sampled/tag-only history andmust not infer blame from incomplete data.

Export a filtered portfolio spanning multiple pages,conditional tasks,completed tasks andmultiple assignees. Preview intended row IDs/count andwhether all orselected rows are included. Reconcile downloaded rows with the authorized snapshot;preserve due versus completion dates andnot-yet-active state. Never silently drop hidden pages orinterpret a missing due date as overdue.

Preview selected time,flat-fee andexpense IDs andold/new dates. Include a locked/invoiced row andan unauthorized matter;reject orclearly separate those outcomes. Preserve raw activity timestamps,individual calls/texts andprior approval versions. Retry without duplicating entries orchanging billing increments. The user’s unrelated billing remark is not adopted as a billing policy.

Switch SMS/secure tabs,refresh andclear browser state. Verify the displayed channel andexplicit compose/send channel remain distinct. Changing accounts orusers cannot expose another matter’s messages. Restoring a last-view preference does not authorize a send orprove message delivery.

Create matters where all three roles differ,with duplicate display names andnull roles. Sort each column ascending/descending across pages;use stable tie-breaks andretain correct role IDs. Filtering/exporting the sorted result must preserve scope andauthorization. Do not rewrite billing ownership when merely sorting.

extended_tests.scenario: Build a three-task chain with day/week/month/year offsets. Before completion,show inactive state rather than an overdue task. Complete the predecessor late;calculate from the actual trigger time. Test reopen,duplicate completion,cycle prevention andcross-matter references without silently replaying finished downstream work.

Expose manual transition versus automatic rule execution explicitly. A manual branch requires an operator andchosen next workflow;an automatic branch needs a configured predicate andexecution evidence. Reject ambiguous outcomes andduplicate branch activation. Preserve previous workflow history.

Create one task with staff/client assignees andfive reminders. Require subject/owner,show each recipient andchannel,andhandle unsupported sixth reminder explicitly. Reminders cannot imply successful notification. Completion,owner andbilling activity remain separate.

Give a workflow generation date distinct from due date;every notification labels the intended due date. Edit an all-day conditional task across timezone/DST boundaries andpreserve its date-only semantics without introducing a clock time.

Complete two selected tasks out of61 filtered matches;onlythose two change. Show cross-page selection scope,permission failures andper-row results. Completion events retain actual actor/time andcannot mark unrelated workflow tasks complete.

Qualify the actual connector version,account,scopes andsupported direction before enabling. Test task creation,completion,reopen,revocation,offline retries andduplicates;do not assume reverse sync orcurrent UI support from this dated guide.

preserved_requirements: All prior practice areas,intake fixes,shared matter context,email filing/client copies,every individual call/text,insurer directory,auto claim forms andAI insurer calls remain included. Attorney letters use I/me/my andfour-digit years.
